Name: Belial's Emblem
Basic Side: A mine is created in each Zone. Each earth player that isn't in the "Play Maker" sequence, begins to mine ore counters.
Condition: If 4 Bergmännlein have collected Ore Counters druing a Play Maker session: Transform Belial
Ultimate Side: For each Player mining during play, gain 1 bonus ore counter. Each Bergmännlein now has access to the ore shop during combat. Accessing the ore shop, counts as the ability trigger, and won't trigger the attack or defend abilites if used.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Valefor's Emblem
Basic Side: A crater hits the middle of the soccer field and drops mine counters in different zones. Only your earth players are able to pick them up.
Condition: If 4 Bergmännlein have collected Ore Counters: Transform Valefor
Ultimate Side: Bergmännlein in the exhaust zone mine ore counters. Each Bergmännlein that was mining the round before is giving +1 power during their next combat.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Haures's Emblem
Basic Side: Replace your goalie with a massive rock unit. When your goalie blocks a goal, drop ore counters and have a Tier IV earth player unit collect them.
Condition: If your Tier IV Bergmännlein have collected 4 Ore Counters: Transform Haures
Ultimate Side: Your goalie is now able to consume ore counters as well. Each ore counter adds armor to the goalie, which gives the goalie a shield and decreases the % change of a goal. Your goalie can only consume 3 ore per cycle.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
